command: evaluation/vlm_baseline.py --docs 20 --tokens <512|1024|2048> --out <this folder>, one process per setting
prompt: Read this invoice and extract three fields: the invoice number, the invoice date and the total amount due. Answer with JSON only, exactly in this form: {"invoice_number": "...", "date": "...", "total": "..."}. Copy each value as it is written on the invoice. Use null for a field that is not on the invoice.
note: One visual-token setting per process (512, 1024, 2048), 20 invoices from spread_indices(20); run_info fields other than started were written by the last process.
